author: neal_illustrator
title: Hiring artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV & Portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Open until all positions are filled.

author: alex.r.gehringer
title: Head of Illustration seeking publishing illustrators
content: My inbox is now open for queries and portfolio submissions! Authors: Check my MSWL page for more information on my latest adult and new adult fiction wishlist. Note I only accept queries via QT. Artists: As newly appointed Head of Illustration, I’m on the hunt for incredible talent for children’s publishing, YA and adult covers, adult lifestyle and more. Send your portfolio and any concept decks to my inbox. As always, across the board: Human work only. AI is not welcome.

author: truchargv
title: Looking for illustrators for article and social pool
content: We're looking for some incredible artists to join our Illustrator pool! Tap the link in bio to apply! Our illustrator pool is used for articles, newsletters, social media posts etc. Illustrators will be chosen and reached out to as needed.
